scoring_justification: Derive ΔE(1,3) and BDE(3) (with and without ZPE) directly from the submitted total electronic energies and zero-point energies, and compare each to the paper’s reported best estimates.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for the four derived energetics (ΔE electronic, ΔE ZPE-corrected, BDE electronic, BDE ZPE-corrected) in kcal mol⁻¹.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper’s declared best estimates: ΔE(1,3) = 8.1 kcal mol⁻¹ (electronic), 8.8 kcal mol⁻¹ (with ZPE); BDE(3) ≈ 39.6 kcal mol⁻¹ (electronic), ≈ 36.0 kcal mol⁻¹ (with ZPE).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper’s text (CCSD(T)/VQZ‑VDZ with BP86 orbitals and B3PW91* ZPE corrections).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numbers the paper reports as its calibrated best first‑principles estimates; they are used to validate a correct reproduction.

outputs.description: Total electronic energies and zero-point energies from which the checker recomputes the singlet–triplet splitting ΔE(1,3) and bond dissociation energy BDE(3) and compares each derived value to the paper's reported best estimates within hidden tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The checker does not access the raw log files; it derives the headline energetics solely from this CSV. All implementation details (functionals, basis sets, orbital choice) are required to follow the paper’s protocol, but the exact values will vary by toolchain—tolerances are chosen to absorb legitimate spread while excluding fabrication.
